spiralCard.title: Your Spiral card
spiralCard.titleReady: Your card is ready to be finalized
spiralCard.trialBody: We hope you're enjoying the free trial, which includes adding up to {{count}} tracks to your library. Purchase a Spiral Card, or add your existing one, to unlock more tracks.
spiralCard.wrapDescription: Full-bleed art for the card face (856×540 recommended).
spiralCard.missingFile: Couldn't find the installed Spiral Card file.
spiralCard.provisionalCopy: Your provisional card grants full access to Spiral. After the refund window ends, you can convert it into a permanent card.
spiralCard.provisionalCopyDated: Your provisional card grants full access to Spiral. After <date>{{date}}</date>, you can convert it into a permanent card.
spiralCard.readyCopy: We'll stamp it as permanent — Spiral is yours, forever. You can change how it looks at any time.
spiralCard.errorUnknownPurchase: We couldn't find your purchase, double-check this card matches your order.
spiralCard.errorRefunded: This purchase was refunded, so permanent registration can't be issued.
spiralCard.replaceBody: The current license and design will be replaced by the new one.
